brandLayer.merge: Concatenate token postings and union aliases and targets; keys and target ids never collide across the two files.

productIndex.rule: Load the shard of each query word's first character; a one-word query also loads the shard of its second character, and a one-word query that is numeric after its first character loads every digit shard. If fewer than the requested results score above containmentCeiling, also load the units the directory entries of every query word share.

resolver.normalization: lowercase, unaccent, strip punctuation, collapse spaces

brandLayer.trigger: First keystroke in a search box, or a submitted query.
